revisions.title: A likely account, not final knowledge
revisions.body: Timaeus marks a limit without declaring the higher principles inaccessible to himself: principles above the two triangles are said to be known to God and a god's friend, while the account proceeds by probable reasoning. Within that account, three kinds can transform through shared material, whereas earth remains structurally separate.
